summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV filed a Form 6-K attaching an October 8, 2026 press release disclosing a Belgian transparency notification received from Bank of America Corporation. BoA, as controlling entity, crossed below the 10% voting-rights threshold on October 2, 2026, following a disposal. After the transaction BoA and affiliates held 254,604 direct voting rights (0.39%) plus 5,371,394 equivalent financial instruments (8.15%), together 8.54% of 65,897,071 outstanding shares; notification was dated October 6, 2026. This is a routine beneficial-ownership threshold disclosure, not a special situation; no board recommendation or advisor. Watch for further stake reductions and instrument unwind, which could pressure the shares.
